originalTitle: Riley Green, Peyton Manning - Alabama Vs. Tennessee (Official Video)
content: The Official Music Video for "Alabama Vs. Tennessee" by Riley Green & Peyton Manning. Yeah, I think this world can learn a thing or two From a couple good ol’ boys like me and you I’m proud to pull for Knoxville It’s ‘bout time for the Tide to take the field We out here in the same bar now Maybe different sides, but we’re settin’ up rounds ‘Cause man, it ain’t you going up against me, no sir It’s Alabama vs. Tennessee It’s just Alabama vs Tennessee We both wear boots and drink cold beer We both like Hank and Merle And we both love country girls You know it, that’s why I married one Yeah, I think this world can learn a thing or two From a couple good ol’ boys like me and you I’m proud to pull for Knoxville Well, I’m proud to pull for Tuscaloosaville We out here in the same bar now Maybe different sides, but we’re settin’ up rounds ‘Cause man, it ain’t you going up against me It’s just Alabama vs. Tennessee Alabama vs. Tennessee Alabama vs. Tennessee Alabama vs. Tennessee Alabama vs. Tennessee #RileyGreen #PeytonManning #AlabamaVsTennessee #CollegeFootball #CountryMusic #MusicVideo #CountrySongs Alabama Vs.
